arStrings.szText: "What can help awaken the Sightless Eye here?"

We depleted the divine magic in the Temple of Life, but there may be another source to awaken the Eye. The tales say Philios first locked the Sightless Eye in a vault close by. Where it is, I do not know.
Another of my order, Laurel, has had visions related to Philios. I hope she has seen where the vault lies. Let us seek her.
